# Requirements Quality Checklist: Eloquent Fresh Save DB005 Coverage

**Purpose**: Formal requirements-quality review for the v0.2 Eloquent fresh-instance `save()` DB005 scope.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are both supported fresh-instance scopes documented: known model plus literal constructor attributes plus `save()` on the same receiver, and known model plus no constructor payload plus supported direct assignments plus `save()` on the same receiver? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are same-receiver constraints specified for construction, assignment, and `save()` evidence so the scope cannot be interpreted as cross-variable or alias-aware? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are loaded-model receivers explicitly protected from fresh-instance insert classification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are independently justified v0.1 DB005 findings explicitly preserved when unrelated ambiguous `save()` calls are present? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Are CLI, JSON, configuration, rule-code, severity, confidence, and exit-code compatibility requirements included for the feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are all required scope exclusions documented, including `saveOrFail()`, `push()`, relationship saves, factories, helper-created models, dependency injection, container resolution, arbitrary aliases, dynamic model classes, general alias/control-flow analysis, and runtime Laravel modeling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Non-Goals]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is supported direct assignment defined with concrete same-receiver assignment forms and literal attribute-name constraints? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Is ambiguous receiver provenance defined clearly enough to distinguish unsupported freshness from recognized fresh-instance evidence? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Is the required-column trigger for DB005 limited to newly added non-nullable columns without a database default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Are confidence and severity semantics explicit that v0.2 recognized fresh-instance `save()` DB005 risk remains `WARNING` / `UNKNOWN` and non-blocking? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Is it explicit that `save()` alone must not become a `BLOCKER` / `DEFINITE` finding when freshness or final persisted columns cannot be proven? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is the phrase “known model” grounded by the feature’s static evidence boundary rather than runtime Laravel model discovery? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the functional requirements align with the constitution’s evidence-before-certainty rule for uncertain Eloquent runtime behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK014 Do v0.1 compatibility requirements align with the constitution’s baseline commit and public-contract stability rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §II, Constitution §IV]
- [x] CHK015 Are the edge cases consistent with the functional requirements for fresh, loaded, and ambiguous receivers? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001 through FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 Are non-goals consistent with FR-012 so the spec does not prematurely require `EloquentInstanceWriteAnalyzer` or any other implementation class? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Non-Goals]
- [x] CHK017 Are Query Builder insert behavior, Eloquent `create()` behavior, unknown dynamic payload behavior, nullable-column behavior, and defaulted-column behavior all specified as stable against v0.1? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are positive fresh-instance cases covered for constructor literal attributes, no-payload construction with supported direct assignments, and literal constructor attributes followed by additional supported assignments? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 Are negative loaded-model cases covered for retrieval, query-result, relationship lookup, `find`-style, and existing update flows? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK020 Are ambiguous provenance negative cases covered for dynamic construction, unsupported aliases, unsupported control flow, uncertain assignment paths, factories, helpers, dependency injection, container resolution, and dynamic model class names? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Non-Goals]
- [x] CHK021 Are preservation scenarios covered for existing DB001 through DB006 contracts, Query Builder behavior, Eloquent `create()` behavior, CLI/JSON/configuration/exit-code behavior, and all 24 canonical v0.1 validation corpus outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-005]

## Test-First Requirements

- [x] CHK022 Does the spec require failing regression tests before implementation for positive fresh-instance cases, loaded-model negatives, ambiguous-provenance negatives, `WARNING` / `UNKNOWN` exit-0 behavior, and v0.1 corpus preservation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK023 Are test-first expectations written as requirements on the eventual implementation workflow rather than as hidden architecture requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 Are test coverage requirements sufficient to prove that `save()` alone does not become a fresh-instance DB005 finding when provenance is ambiguous? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 Are success criteria measurable with concrete counts or observable contract outcomes for positive, loaded-model, ambiguous, exit-code, v0.1 corpus, and non-blocker preservation scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 through SC-006]
- [x] CHK026 Do success criteria map cleanly to functional requirements without introducing behavior outside the stated feature scope? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001 through FR-014, Spec §SC-001 through SC-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is the 24-scenario v0.1 validation corpus compatibility criterion explicit enough to evaluate against the existing canonical corpus? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-005]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK028 Are there no unresolved placeholders, TODOs, bracketed unknowns, or draft notes that would block planning? [Ambiguity, Spec §Full Document]
- [x] CHK029 Are there no contradictions between fresh-instance recognition, ambiguous-provenance rejection, loaded-model protection, and v0.1 compatibility preservation? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001 through FR-014]
- [x] CHK030 Are architecture-sensitive terms kept out of binding requirements so planning can choose implementation structure without violating the spec? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Non-Goals]
